auto_capture.description: Allow merchant to trigger auto capturing.

merchant_reference1.description: Used for storing merchant's internal order number or other reference. If set, will be shown on the confirmation page as "order number" (max 255 characters).

merchant_reference2.description: Used for storing merchant's internal order number or other reference (max 255 characters).

order_amount.description: Non-negative, minor units. Total amount of the order, including tax and any discounts.

order_tax_amount.description: Non-negative, minor units. The total tax amount of the order.

country.description: Customers country. This value overrides the purchase country if they are different. Should follow the standard of ISO 3166 alpha-2. E.g. GB, US, DE, SE.

organization_name.description: Organization name (if applicable). Only applicable for B2B customers.

phone.description: Phone number. Preferably a mobile phone number.

postal_code.description:
Customers postal code. Validation according to [Universal Postal Union addressing system](https://www.upu.int/en/activities/addressing/postal-addressing-systems-in-member-countries.html)
E.g. 12345, W1G OPW.

region.description: Customers region or state - Mandatory for US and AU market. Validations according to ISO 3166-2 format, e.g. OH, NJ, etc.

street_address.description:
Customers street address.Validation according to [Universal Postal Union addressing system](https://www.upu.int/en/activities/addressing/postal-addressing-systems-in-member-countries.html). Regional formatting is required, as follows:
UK/US/FR: 33 Cavendish Square
Rest of EU: De Ruijterkade 7

title.description:
Customers Title. Allowed values per country:
UK - "Mr", "Ms"
DE - "Herr", "Frau"
AT: "Herr, "Frau"
CH: de-CH: "Herr, "Frau" it-CH: "Sig.", "Sig.ra" fr-CH: "M", "Mme" 
BE: "Dhr.", "Mevr."
NL: "Dhr.", "Mevr."

body.description: The content of the extra merchant data should be presented as a string inside this property. The body should be an object containing any of the keys and sub-objects described below serialized to JSON. More information on that object can be found [here](https://docs.klarna.com/api/extra-merchant-data).

content_type.description: The content type of the body. It is usually represented as "application/vnd.klarna.internal.emd-v2+json"

confirmation.description: URL of merchant confirmation page. (max 2000 characters)

push.description: URL that will be requested when an order is completed. Should be different than checkout and confirmation URLs. (max 2000 characters)

image_url.description:
URL to an image that can be later embedded in communications between Klarna and the customer. (max 1024 characters).
 A minimum of 250x250 px resolution is recommended for the image to look good in the Klarna app, and below 50x50 px won't even show. We recommend using a good sized image (650x650 px or more), however the file size must not exceed 12MB.

merchant_data.description: Used for storing merchant's internal order number or other reference. Pass through field. (max 255 characters)

name.description: Descriptive name of the order line item.

product_url.description: URL to the product in the merchants webshop that can be later used in communications between Klarna and the customer. (max 1024 characters)

quantity.description: Quantity of the order line item. Must be a non-negative number.

quantity_unit.description: Unit used to describe the quantity, e.g. kg, pcs, etc. If defined the value has to be 1-8 characters.

reference.description: Client facing article number, SKU or similar. Max length is 256 characters.

tax_rate.description: Tax rate of the order line. Non-negative value. The percentage value is represented with two implicit decimals. I.e 1900 = 19%.

total_amount.description:
Total amount of the order line. Must be defined as non-negative minor units. Includes tax and discount. Eg: 2500=25 euros
Value = (quantity x unit_price) - total_discount_amount. 
(max value: 100000000)

total_discount_amount.description: Non-negative minor units. Includes tax. Eg: 500=5 euros

total_tax_amount.description: Total tax amount of the order line. Must be within �1 of total_amount - total_amount 10000 / (10000 + tax_rate). Negative when type is discount.

type.description: Type of the order line item.

unit_price.description: Price for a single unit of the order line. Non-negative minor units. Includes tax, excludes discount. (max value: 100000000)

brand.description: The product's brand name as generally recognized by consumers. If no brand is available for a product, do not supply any value.

category_path.description: The product's category path as used in the merchant's webshop. Include the full and most detailed category and separate the segments with ' > '

global_trade_item_number.description: The product's Global Trade Item Number (GTIN). Common types of GTIN are EAN, ISBN or UPC. Exclude dashes and spaces, where possible

manufacturer_part_number.description: The product's Manufacturer Part Number (MPN), which - together with the brand - uniquely identifies a product. Only submit MPNs assigned by a manufacturer and use the most specific MPN possible

color.description: Color to be shown to the end customer (max 64 characters).

size.description: Size to be shown to the end customer (max 64 characters).

name.description: The name of the subscription product
